## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Field blocks for Thuringia, Germany](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for Thuringia (TH), Germany

Provides ca. 100.000 official field boundaries from the federal state of Thuringia (TH) in Germany.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from a file that was provided by the state.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Thüringer Landesamt für Landwirtschaft und Ländlichen Raum](https://geomis.geoportal-th.de/geonetwork/srv/ger/catalog.search#/metadata/D872F2D6-60BC-11D6-B67D-00E0290F5BA0)
- **Converted by:** [Matthias Mohr](https://mohr.ws)
- **License:** [Germany - attribution - Version 2.0](https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0)

---

- **[Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/de-th/de-th.parquet)**
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/de-th/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/de-th/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/de-th/de-th.pmtiles)

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-08-13 from https://www.geoproxy.geoportal-th.de/download-service/opendata/agrar/DGK_Thue.zip.
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.6.0.
